purpose: Seven complete prepared DimensionSearch executions: n=1,2,3,4,5,8,9. Independent numeric bit conversion supplies expected dimension,square,entry width,threshold and retained length. All12absolute heads,unit,zero,one-bit fuel,prepared scratch,andblank product/repeatFuel/copyThreshold checked. Actual step counts are reported. All-input native trace,integer correctness and7260L bound are separately proved.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.DimensionSearchLoop
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def advanceBits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map (fun j => n.testBit j)
def advanceWidth (k : Nat) : Nat := max 1 (k-1).size
def advanceWords (m k : Nat) : DimensionAdvance.Words :=
  ⟨advanceBits m k,advanceBits m (k*k),advanceBits m (advanceWidth k),advanceBits m (2^advanceWidth k)⟩
def advanceMarkedExact (word : Tape Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (word.left.headD .blank=.start) && word.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  decide (word.right.take (xs.length+1)=symbols xs++[.stop]) &&
  (word.right.drop (xs.length+1)).all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))
def advancePrepared (word : Tape Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (word.left.headD .blank=.start) && word.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  word.right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))
def advanceBlank (word : Tape Bool) : Bool :=
  word.left.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) && word.right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))

def searchPorts : List DimensionSearch.Port :=
  [.candidate,.square,.bits,.threshold,.unit,.zero,.fuel,.scratch,.copyThreshold,.product,.repeatFuel,.length]
def searchHeads : DimensionSearch.Port → Int
  | .candidate => -7 | .square => 29 | .bits => -51 | .threshold => 5 | .unit => 100
  | .zero => -99 | .fuel => 17 | .scratch => 0 | .copyThreshold => 64
  | .product => -101 | .repeatFuel => 87 | .length => 300

def searchSnapshot (c : NativeZipper.Config DimensionSearch.Port DimensionSearch.Label) : NativeZipper.Config DimensionSearch.Port DimensionSearch.Label :=
  let t0 := c.core.tapes .candidate
  let h0 := c.pos .candidate
  let t1 := c.core.tapes .square
  let h1 := c.pos .square
  let t2 := c.core.tapes .bits
  let h2 := c.pos .bits
  let t3 := c.core.tapes .threshold
  let h3 := c.pos .threshold
  let t4 := c.core.tapes .unit
  let h4 := c.pos .unit
  let t5 := c.core.tapes .zero
  let h5 := c.pos .zero
  let t6 := c.core.tapes .fuel
  let h6 := c.pos .fuel
  let t7 := c.core.tapes .scratch
  let h7 := c.pos .scratch
  let t8 := c.core.tapes .copyThreshold
  let h8 := c.pos .copyThreshold
  let t9 := c.core.tapes .product
  let h9 := c.pos .product
  let t10 := c.core.tapes .repeatFuel
  let h10 := c.pos .repeatFuel
  let t11 := c.core.tapes .length
  let h11 := c.pos .length
  ⟨⟨c.core.pc,fun p => match p with
    | .candidate => t0
    | .square => t1
    | .bits => t2
    | .threshold => t3
    | .unit => t4
    | .zero => t5
    | .fuel => t6
    | .scratch => t7
    | .copyThreshold => t8
    | .product => t9
    | .repeatFuel => t10
    | .length => t11
  ⟩,fun p => match p with
    | .candidate => h0
    | .square => h1
    | .bits => h2
    | .threshold => h3
    | .unit => h4
    | .zero => h5
    | .fuel => h6
    | .scratch => h7
    | .copyThreshold => h8
    | .product => h9
    | .repeatFuel => h10
    | .length => h11
  ⟩

theorem searchSnapshot_eq (c : NativeZipper.Config DimensionSearch.Port DimensionSearch.Label) : searchSnapshot c=c := by
  cases c with
  | mk core pos =>
    cases core with
    | mk pc tapes =>
      dsimp only [searchSnapshot]
      congr 2 <;> funext p <;> cases p <;> rfl

-- Stop the supplemental interpreter at its actual halt/reject instruction.
-- The production controller has no supplied run bound; this is test fuel only.
def searchRun : Nat → Nat → NativeZipper.Config DimensionSearch.Port DimensionSearch.Label →
    Nat × NativeZipper.Config DimensionSearch.Port DimensionSearch.Label
  | 0,t,c => (t,c)
  | fuel+1,t,c => match DimensionSearch.program c.core.pc with
    | .halt | .reject => (t,c)
    | _ => searchRun fuel (t+1) (searchSnapshot (NativeZipper.step DimensionSearch.program c))

def dimensionSearchCheck (n : Nat) : Nat × Bool :=
  let L:=n*n*advanceWidth n
  let m:=2*L.size+4
  let w:=advanceWords m 1
  let c : NativeZipper.Config DimensionSearch.Port DimensionSearch.Label :=
    ⟨⟨DimensionSearch.start,DimensionSearch.initial w m (advanceBits m L)⟩,searchHeads⟩
  let (t,r):=searchRun (7260*L) 0 c
  (t,decide (r.core.pc=.done) && searchPorts.all (fun p => decide (r.pos p=searchHeads p)) &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .candidate) (advanceBits m n) &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .square) (advanceBits m (n*n)) &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .bits) (advanceBits m (advanceWidth n)) &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .threshold) (advanceBits m (2^advanceWidth n)) &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .unit) (advanceBits m 1) &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .zero) (advanceBits m 0) &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .fuel) [true] &&
    advanceMarkedExact (r.core.tapes .length) (advanceBits m L) &&
    advancePrepared (r.core.tapes .scratch) && advanceBlank (r.core.tapes .copyThreshold) &&
    advanceBlank (r.core.tapes .product) && advanceBlank (r.core.tapes .repeatFuel))

#eval [1,2,3,4,5,8,9].map (fun n => (n,dimensionSearchCheck n))
interpreter_representation: searchSnapshot_eq is kernel checked in this source. Materializing all twelve tape/head values prevents nested host-function reevaluation;it preserves the configuration exactly. Early stopping occurs only at actual halt/reject instructions. No production instruction or time bound is changed.

superseded_execution.reason: Stopped after the equivalent materialized evaluation passed;the original host representation accumulated nested functions. This is an interpreter-representation fix,not a restart solely for elapsed time.
